item.title: Industrial Relations Code (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2025 – Continuity of Adjudication for Pending Cases
item.description: The Industrial Relations Code (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2025 ensures smooth transition by transferring pending cases under old labour laws to corresponding tribunals under the new Code while maintaining adjudication continuity. The post Industrial Relations Code (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2025 – Continuity of Adjudication for Pending Cases appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Sheela Foam Limited on further investment in Furlenco via preferential issue and structuring investor rights in the funding round. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted as the legal advisor to Sheela Foam Limited appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Fourth IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium (Day 2): Spotlight on Emerging Intellectual Property and AI Issues
item.description: The session explored how artificial intelligence is reshaping intellectual property law, from data-scraping and authorship debates to personality rights and deepfake misuse. The discussion underscored the need for clearer safeguards, transparency obligations and balanced governance frameworks as AI accelerates real-world disputes. The post Fourth IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium (Day 2): Spotlight on Emerging Intellectual Property and AI Issues appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: RBI Issues 7 Amendment Directions on Responsible Business Conduct & BSBD Account Rules Effective April 2026
item.description: Reserve Bank of India has announced seven amendment directions on Responsible Business Conduct, effective April 1, 2026. These changes aim to modernize Basic Savings Bank Deposit (BSBD) accounts, introducing free essential banking facilities, digital payment norms, and customer-friendly options to promote financial inclusion in a digital era. The post RBI Issues 7 Amendment Directions on Responsible Business Conduct & BSBD Account Rules Effective April 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Navigating Social Media: Privacy, Freedom of Speech and Regulation | Conclusion of Fourth IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium
item.description: The Fourth IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium concluded with a panel discussion on privacy and the new Digital Personal Data Protection Act as well as a debate on whether social media was the only reliable source of news. The post Navigating Social Media: Privacy, Freedom of Speech and Regulation | Conclusion of Fourth IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium appeared first on SCC Times.
